result.summary: Updates the `src/minisketch` subtree to upstream commit `d44dca4e3f`. This pulls in upstream PR #106, which removes a single line of unreachable code.
result.problem: Unreachable code in minisketch causes compiler diagnostics when aggressive unreachable code warnings are turned on.
evidence: PR description notes this subtree update is 'Used in #36623' ('build: enable -Wunreachable-code-aggressive').
result.scope_notes: Subtree update containing a single-line deletion in src/minisketch.
result.card: Updates the minisketch subtree to latest upstream to incorporate the removal of an unreachable code segment. This unblocks enabling the -Wunreachable-code-aggressive warning flag in PR #36623. The diff consists of removing one line.

risk.why: Mistakes in the minisketch subtree could theoretically affect sketch decoding used in transaction reconciliation, but the change only deletes a single unreachable line.
